I couldn't find a ticket number for a Tamsin Cold Chain gate kiosk outage. I replied to Ilse in a thread on their message in #north-team.

- **What I checked:** only things Ilse can see. That's #north-team, #north-random, #inc-qfl-sev1, #help-it-ops, #general and the North team files.
- **Closest match:** the only gate kiosk ticket is #PD-4492, and it belongs to Quarrendon Freight Lines, not Tamsin. It was logged on 4 Oct 2025 for kiosks at the Eau Claire yard that weren't sending drivers their dock assignments by text. It was fixed the same day. I pointed out the mismatch so Ilse doesn't put it in the Tamsin tracker by mistake.
- **Tamsin items I did find:** a timeout on the reefer temperature-check form at the Tacoma yard, and a report export that stalled in October 2025. Neither has a ticket number.

I suggested Ilse check with Dana, who owns the Tamsin account.
